messages:
maya: Heads up — after the KMS key policy tweak for the cert-issuer SA (~09:00 UTC) we're seeing intermittent TLS handshakes fail between svc-proxy-west -> svc-core-east. Envoy logs show ALPN negotiation errors. Affects staging and a few canaries, not prod yet. Anyone oncall?
liam: I'm oncall, can you paste the envoy error lines and the KMS policy change diff?
maya: paste logs: ```[2025-03-20T09:12:34Z] envoy[svc-proxy-west] connection rejected peer=svc-core-east err=TLS alert: handshake failure (ALPN mismatch) cert_key=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck/versions/3```
ana: (cc @ana) do we have a commit/PR for the policy change? I vaguely remember removing a decrypt grant to a service account for hardening.
nana: actually meant @ana :)
nana: sorry typo
ana: @maya can you confirm whether the cert-issuer uses KMS decrypt or asymmetric sign for the issuing flow?
maya: cert-issuer uses KMS asymmetric keys (asymmetricSign) for CA signing and also uses cryptoKeyVersions for key material fetch. The change removed a binding that included serviceAccount:cert-issuer@infra-prod.
nana: that could explain key version mismatch if issuer fell back to a cached older cert format that advertises a different ALPN.
tom: Quick checks: 1) See Cloud KMS audit logs for cryptoKeyVersions.access or cryptoKeyVersions.use. 2) Check envoy config for ALPN list (http/1.1 vs h2).
liam: command to pull logs: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName: "AsymmetricSign"' --freshness=1h`
maya: ran that, not seeing AsymmetricSign entries from svc-proxy-west nodes for the 09:00-09:15 window; svc-core-east shows normal traffic.
security-bot: Alert: Missing KMS 'AsymmetricSign' audit entries for service=svc-proxy-west between 2025-03-20T09:05:00Z and 2025-03-20T09:20:00Z. Possible IAM deny or regional routing mismatch.
nana: Are svc-proxy-west instances in a different GCP project or VPC that might hit a different key resource (regional replica)? We recently enabled multi-region key replicas.
maya: They hit the same key name but different keyVersion id (v3 for east, v4 for west) — policy change may not have been applied to the west key version's resource-level binding.
tom: If KMS denies, cert-issuer could fallback to previously cached cert chain that advertises ALPN 'http/1.1' while new services expect 'h2'. That triggers ALPN mismatch at handshake.
liam: Short-term mitigation options: 1) Re-add temporary decrypt/sign binding for cert-issuer SA to the west keyVersion(s). 2) Configure envoy to accept both ALPNs (allow fallback) until certs are reissued. 3) Rollback KMS policy change.
nana: I can re-add the binding quickly if we want — but we should record the exact audit event for change roll-forward.
nana: Proposed command to add binding (example): `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ck --location=us-west1 --keyring=kr --member=serviceAccount:cert-issuer@infra-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
maya: Also suggest we force-issue new leaf certs from cert-issuer after grant restored so ALPN metadata aligns.
nana: +1. Also add an Ops alert for missing `AsymmetricSign` records per node so future policy edits trigger immediate detection.
liam: I'll coordinate rollback if needed. @infra-oncall can you standby for a possible rollback of the policy?
infra-oncall: standing by. If we do rollback, we should do it as a targeted binding change (minimal blast radius) not a full key permission revert. Also we should document region-scoped key-version bindings.
maya: I'm going to open an incident record: INC-2025-174 (east-west TLS ALPN mismatch post-KMS policy change). Will include timeline and runbook steps.
maya: Action plan for next 30 mins: (1) ana re-add temp binding to west key versions (2) lia m confirm audit entries appear (3) cert-issuer re-issue certs and push to proxies (4) tom monitor envoy handshake success rate.
nana: Doing step (1) now. ETA ~6m.
liam: Once binding is in place, run this to validate AsymmetricSign shows up: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="AsymmetricSign" AND resource.labels.key_ring="kr"' --limit=50`
maya: Update: binding added at 2025-03-20T09:18:32Z. I triggered re-issuance of certs. Handshake failures dropped dramatically within ~7 minutes.
nana: Verified AsymmetricSign entries for svc-proxy-west starting 2025-03-20T09:19:00Z.
infra-oncall: Good — please keep the temp binding until we have a formal migration/region-binding plan. We'll schedule a controlled hardening with tests.
liam: Followups: 1) Add an automated audit rule to alert on missing KMS usage per service over 5m. 2) Add a preflight test in the KMS policy PR template that runs region-scoped key access checks. 3) Update our cert-issuance playbook to include ALPN validation and to prefer explicit ALPN fields in cert metadata.
maya: I'll write the incident summary and followups. Thanks everyone. Closing this thread once doc is posted.
liam: :thumbsup:
security-bot: Incident INC-2025-174 updated: status=mitigated tags=[kms,alpn,rbac,audit].
maya: Postmortem action items created and assigned. We'll schedule a runbook update session tomorrow.
